text: Added canonical validated Axes with pure invalid-rank, invalid-axis, and duplicate-axis errors. Sum, product, min, max, and mean now accept Axes plus keep-dimensions overloads; varargs conveniences share the same validation. MultiReductionPlan computes output and reduced domains once and direct primitive kernels traverse selected axes in canonical source-axis C-order with no sequential intermediate. Floating blocks retain the 128-value pairwise schedule independent of caller axis order; overflow-safe block counts avoid Int addition overflow. Multi-axis arg reductions are compile-tested and documented as deferred. Added empty-axis/domain, NaN, signed-zero, wraparound, negative-stride, borrowed-ownership, exact-bit, and JVM allocation tests. Evidence: sbt fmtCheck testAllFull representationProof docsCheck passed; core JVM 187, core JS 182, browser 3/3, full JS links and docs green; pre/post browser audits clean; git diff --check and sequential-source audit passed.
